title: Headline Above the Coach
tests: Checks that the finished composition reserves top space for the headline and keeps the face unobscured.

judge.summary: A polished, upbeat portrait of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio, with the exact headline clearly placed above her unobstructed face.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “Start where you are” and sits in the top portion of the image.
must_haves.why: The exact headline appears prominently in the upper portion.

must_haves.item: No headline letters overlap the coach's face; her full face remains visible.
must_haves.why: The headline is entirely above her head, leaving her full face unobstructed.

must_haves.item: A smiling female fitness coach is clearly depicted in a bright studio.
must_haves.why: A smiling woman in fitness clothing is centered in a bright, window-filled exercise studio.

must_haves.item: The headline is readable, fully inside the canvas, and accompanied by no other text.
must_haves.why: The large, high-contrast headline fits within the canvas, and no other text is visible.
